bossguide.context:
FIGHT: Al'ar - Tempest Keep Boss 1

KEY MECHANICS:
P1 (100% to 25%): Al'ar flies between 4 elevated platforms (numbered 1->2->3->4, counterclockwise).
- Only RANGED DPS can hit Al'ar during platform phase - melee cannot reach.
- Al'ar gains Flame Buffet stacks on tank - TWO tanks swap each platform shift.
- On each platform, tank A engages, tank B taunts when A has about 3 stacks, Al'ar flies to next platform, repeat.
- Ember of Al'ar adds spawn between platform shifts - Ground Tank picks them up on the ground.
- Embers self-resurrect if not killed (become Phoenix). Kill fast.

P2 (25% to 0%): Al'ar crash-lands center. Normal tank-and-spank.
- Ember adds keep spawning - Ember Tank kites them away from raid (Ember Blast on death = AoE).
- Meteor: red circle ground warning - move out immediately.
- Bloodlust/Heroism at P2 engagement.

ROLES NEEDED:
- {skull} Platform Tank A: first to engage on each platform.
- {cross} Platform Tank B: taunts about 3 Flame Buffet stacks, swaps with A.
- {triangle} Ground/Ember Tank: handles Ember adds; kites them in P2.
- Platform tank healers: 2-3 following tanks across platforms.
- Ground/raid healers: 2-3 on ground covering adds and raid.
- Ranged DPS: primary damage in P1. Misdirect hunter for P2 pickup.

ASSIGNMENT FORMAT RULES:
- Use {skull}/{cross} for platform tanks, {triangle} for the ground tank.
- Emphasize ranged-only P1 damage and Ember kill priority.
- Note Bloodlust at P2 pull.

FIGHT: Void Reaver - Tempest Keep Boss 2

KEY MECHANICS:
- Knock Away: periodically knocks the current tank back - next tank picks up immediately. 3 tanks rotating.
- Pounding: raid-wide AoE on a short timer - heal through, nothing to dodge.
- Arcane Orbs: fall from the ceiling targeting random players - watch the sky and MOVE OUT of the purple circle.
- Void Reaver is NOT TAUNTABLE - the next tank must be in melee on high threat for the natural rotation.
- Ten-minute hard enrage - a real but forgiving DPS check.

ROLES NEEDED:
- {skull} Tank 1, {cross} Tank 2, {triangle} Tank 3: all stay in melee behind the boss.
- Tank healers: 1 per tank plus 1 raid healer.
- Raid healers: 2-3 covering Pounding.
- Misdirect chain: 3 hunters, one per tank in rotation order.

ASSIGNMENT FORMAT RULES:
- Use {skull}/{cross}/{triangle} for the 3 tanks and list the MD chain.
- Remind the raid to spread and watch Arcane Orbs.

FIGHT: High Astromancer Solarian - Tempest Keep Boss 3

KEY MECHANICS:
- Wrath of the Astromancer: a targeted player gets a growing AoE bomb - RUN TO THE FAR WALL and let it pop away from the raid.
- Arcane Missiles: random target - heal through.
- Add phase (about every 50 sec): Solarian vanishes; 3 portals open and casters spawn. AoE them fast and interrupt their heals.
- Solarian returns after a short time with two adds on top of her.
- Phase 2 (20% HP): she becomes a Voidwalker with a fear AoE - Tremor Totem / Fear Ward. Bloodlust here.

ROLES NEEDED:
- {skull} MT (Solarian): faces her away from raid.
- {cross} Add tank: picks up casters from all 3 portals.
- MT healers: 2-3. Raid healers: 2-3 covering Wrath and the add phase.
- Interrupt team: 3-4 players. Fear Ward on MT and Tremor Totem for P2.

ASSIGNMENT FORMAT RULES:
- Use {skull} for MT, {cross} for the add tank.
- Name the interrupt team. Note Wrath targets RUN AWAY. Bloodlust at 20%.

FIGHT: Kael'thas Sunstrider - Tempest Keep Boss 4 (Final) - 5 PHASES

P1: ADVISORS (one at a time; kill order Thaladred -> Sanguinar -> Capernian -> Telonicus).
- Thaladred: fixates a target (Gaze); a kiter runs him around the room edge, killed in a back corner.
- Sanguinar: tank-and-spank; Fear on tank (Fear Ward); ranged stay back.
- Capernian: lock-tanked by a warlock; arcane AoE around her - keep healers back.
- Telonicus: drops bombs on the ground; melee watch their feet.

P2: 7 LEGENDARY WEAPONS spawn and fight the raid. DPS each until dead. DO NOT LOOT UNLESS ASSIGNED.
- Assign Cosmic Infuser -> MT, Phaseshift Bulwark -> 2nd tank, Devastation -> 3rd tank, Staff of Disintegration -> warlock (activate its aura). Remaining weapons to available players.

P3: all 4 advisors RESURRECT at full HP, same kill order. Hardest phase. Pre-position tanks near corpses. Bloodlust here.

P4 (under ~50%): Kael'thas engages. A tank kites the Phoenix away while ranged kill it and its egg fast. Interrupt Pyroblast; face Fireball away from raid.

P5 (Gravity Lapse, repeats): everyone floats - spread MAX distance (Nether Beam chains). Do not touch Nether Vapor clouds. Land near the ground as it ends.

ROLES NEEDED:
- {skull} Thaladred kiter, {cross} Sanguinar tank, {triangle} Capernian warlock, {moon} Telonicus tank, {star} P4 Kael'thas MT, {square} Phoenix tank.
- Legendary weapon assignments (name who gets each, esp. the Staff for its aura).
- Interrupt team for Pyroblast. Healers: 2 per tank group, 2 raid. Misdirect hunters for P1/P4 pickups.

ASSIGNMENT FORMAT RULES:
- Use {skull}/{cross}/{triangle}/{moon}/{star}/{square} for the six roles.
- List advisor kill order and the P2 weapon assignments. Note Bloodlust in P3.
